routing.assessment: These were bounded, single-session, read-only investigations. Even the longest trajectory reached the correct mechanism without losing consequential state, so there is no concrete evidence that durable notes would have prevented a mistake.

cost_interpretation.important_context: Scenario 17 was a 402-second, 6.0-million-input-token, 37-tool-action outlier. Multiple runs emitted oversized search results and retried unavailable shell utilities. No Wayfinder instruction, artifact, or action contributed to this overhead.
